title: Packages marked delivered by carrier but not received by customers
situation: Multiple customers report orders marked as delivered by the carrier while not actually received, risking immediate chargebacks and trust loss if not addressed today.

params.reply_en: We see your order was marked as delivered, but you haven't received it. We are checking with the carrier right now and will follow up with you by tomorrow.
params.reply_ar: نرى أن طلبك قد تم تحديثه كـ "تم التوصيل" ولكنك لم تستلمه بعد. نحن نتحقق من الأمر مع شركة الشحن وسنتابع معك بحلول الغد.

actions.why: Acknowledge the carrier issue and reassure customers that we are investigating.

params.note: Carrier incorrectly marking packages as delivered before actual drop-off.

actions.why: Needs logistics team to investigate the delivery driver route and GPS scans.

reply_other.fr: Nous voyons que votre commande a été marquée comme livrée mais vous ne l'avez pas reçue. Nous vérifions auprès du transporteur et vous tiendrons informés.
reply_other.es: Vemos que tu pedido aparece como entregado pero no lo has recibido. Lo estamos consultando con el transportista y te daremos respuesta pronto.

alternatives.why: Could be porch piracy rather than carrier error.
Customers might have outdated delivery addresses.
